summary: UBS AG filed a Form 6-K providing supplemental disclosure on consolidated capitalization as of June 30, 2026, including debt issued and equity attributable to shareholders, prepared under IFRS. This routine periodic report updates capitalization figures and incorporates them into existing registration statements. No special situation such as acquisition, spin-off, or restructuring is announced. The filing is purely informational for investors, without any event indicative of corporate action. The role is that of a filer submitting a customary report, and the content does not trigger any category of special situations.
